title: Pages — first-run message where Pages opens

steps.path: Click Pages in the top left with no pages yet
steps.headline: The first-run explanation now appears as soon as you open Pages.
steps.changed: The existing explanation and Make a page button move into the main page area, replacing the bare No page selected message for an empty library.
steps.notice: You can learn what a page is and start making one without going through Manage pages. On a phone, the empty sidebar steps aside so the card fits.

steps.path: Pages → Manage pages with no pages yet
steps.headline: Manage pages no longer repeats the first-run message.
steps.changed: Manage pages keeps its header and Make a page action, but the onboarding card belongs on the first screen.
steps.notice: The management list is empty until you make a page. Back returns to the explanation.
steps.risk: Manage pages is a blank list when there are no pages; its header still offers Make a page.
